history.content: i think im just annoyed. my sister didnt show up to my kids birthday and didnt even text
Annoyed fits here, and it also sounds like there’s some hurt or feeling brushed aside underneath it. What part of her not showing up landed the hardest?
i guess that she just forgot. like we werent even worth a reminder in her phone. shes my sister
That sounds like it might be more than annoyance, maybe hurt with a kind of being overlooked in it. Her being your sister seems to make that land even sharper.
yeah. overlooked is the word. my kid kept asking where auntie was and i didnt know what to say
Overlooked seems right, and there’s also the sting of having to answer your kid while you were still taking it in.
yeah that was the worst part. anyway. thanks for letting me get that out
Yeah, that was the worst part. We can leave it there, and I’m glad you said it out loud.
